name: stale_aggregate
description: In main.go, `updateLineitem` updates `lineitem.l_extendedprice`, `l_discount`, and `l_tax` for an existing order but never recalculates or updates the parent `orders.o_totalprice`. The read endpoint `getOrder` then serves `o_totalprice` directly from `orders`, so after a line item change it can return a stale aggregate instead of the current sum derived from `lineitem` rows.
